title: Tanzania for Photographers: Where and When
excerpt: Where and when to go in Tanzania for the best wildlife and landscape photography.
body:
## Big cats

Central Serengeti and Ndutu (January–March).

## Migration

Northern Serengeti (July–October).

## Elephants and baobabs

Tarangire (dry season).

## Landscapes

Ngorongoro, Lake Natron, Kilimanjaro.

## Light

Golden hours after sunrise and before sunset.

## Private vehicle

Essential for photographers.

## Gear

See [camera gear](/blog/safari-photography-gear/) and [migration photography](/blog/migration-photography-tips/).

[Plan your photography safari](/travel-proposal/).
